# Career Skills Center

> Career Skills Center is a career school in Massachusetts offering career-focused training in the skilled trades, information technology, and the medical field. Programs are short, hands-on where it matters, and built around the credentials employers actually hire for, with online and hands-on training options. Located in Quincy, MA. Phone: (617) 544-7155. Email: info@careerskillscenter.com.

## Programs
- [Our Programs](https://careerskillscenter.com/our-programs.html): Overview of all training programs.
- [Skilled Trades](https://careerskillscenter.com/skilled-trades.html): Hands-on trades training (electrical, HVAC/R, plumbing, welding, carpentry) — program details coming soon.
- [IT Support Specialist](https://careerskillscenter.com/it-support-specialist.html): Online IT support training preparing students for the CompTIA Tech+ (FC0-U71) certification, about 8 weeks, no experience required.
- [Medical Billing & Coding](https://careerskillscenter.com/medical-billing-coding.html): Online medical billing and coding training preparing students for the AAPC CPC and CPB certifications, about 11 weeks.
